sentences.en: I attributed the delay in delivery to a traffic jam.
sentences.zh: 我把延误归咎于交通堵塞。

sentences.en: This is bulky, so I'll send it by home delivery.
sentences.zh: 这个东西体积大，我让快递员送货上门。

sentences.en: Please estimate your best price and the earliest delivery date.
sentences.zh: 请给我报个最优价格和最早送达日期。

phrases.zh: 送奶工（此处为送外卖的）

senses.zh: 递送，投递；分娩，生产；演讲方式，表达方式
